records.rule: trailofbits.python.tarfile-extractall-traversal.tarfile-extractall-traversal
records.detail: modules/gitlibs.py:308. The module-archive extraction pre-checks every member with realpath + commonpath against the destination, caps entries (10,000) and uncompressed size (1 GiB), extracts with filter='data', and refuses to run on a Python without tarfile.data_filter. The zip branch gets the same member pre-check.

records.rule: python.lang.security.audit.non-literal-import.non-literal-import
records.detail: config_loader.py:89/144, drawing.py:174/179, drawio_emitter.py:141/152/201, graphmaker.py:1952, tfwrapper.py:904. Each import name is built from a provider already limited to aws/azure/gcp (or a hard-coded tuple, or a mapping lookup) and walks only the package's own modules. No input chooses the module.
